facts.material: cast iron or ductile iron body, stainless steel perforated screen
facts.function: removes particulate matter and debris from process fluids (water, oil, gas) to protect pumps, valves, heat exchangers; no moving parts
facts.form: complete flanged inline strainer with hinged bolted cover and blowoff plugs

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8421 covers filtering or purifying machinery and apparatus for liquids or gases; static equipment with no moving parts is included per HQ 964174 analysis of the EN; chapter 84 note 1 does not exclude it
GRI 1: heading 7326 (other articles of iron or steel) and 8481 (valves) are not apt: a strainer separates solids from fluid and is not a valve
GRI 6: 8421.2 filtering apparatus for liquids, 8421.29 other, .00.65 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: residual iron/steel articles; HQ 964174 revoked that treatment of Y strainers since heading 8421 covers them
pipe fittings connect pipe lengths; a strainer is a filtering apparatus, not a fitting
valves and taps regulate flow; a strainer has no flow-control function
gas filtering apparatus; principal function is liquid (water, oil) line filtration

missing_facts: whether use is principally with liquids or gases
classification.rationale: Y-type line strainers with a body, screen and cover were held by HQ 964174 to be heading 8421 filtering apparatus for liquids (8421.29.00). These LPD strainers are the same kind of goods. Suffix .65 is the residual Other under 8421.29.00.
